issues.name: App feels worse and less useful after recent update
issues.summary: Customers say recent updates made the app useless or disappointing, and report bugs such as music adjustment not working properly.

issues.name: Basic music controls locked behind Premium paywall
issues.summary: Customers say basic features like picking specific songs, playing next tracks, and unlimited skipping now require a Premium subscription.

issues.name: Frequent ads interrupt listening for free users
issues.summary: Customers report ads playing every one or two songs, with many saying ads are excessive and driving them to consider uninstalling.

issues.name: Music stops randomly or skips during playback
issues.summary: Customers report playback halting midway, failing to resume where it left off, and randomly stopping even with a strong connection.

issues.name: Cannot log in, app reports false no-internet error
issues.summary: Customers say they cannot get into their account and the app claims there is no internet connection even when other apps and downloads work.

issues.name: Player controls removed and song navigation confusing
issues.summary: Customers say basic player features were removed in an update, such as rewinding a few seconds, and that tapping liked songs plays unexpected tracks or demos.

issues.name: App crashes or fails to open after update
issues.summary: Customers report the app crashing during playback or refusing to open since the latest update.

issues.name: New home screen and layout disliked by users
issues.summary: Customers say the redesigned home screen and layout are awful and that basic features they relied on have been removed.

issues.name: Many songs and artists are unavailable
issues.summary: Customers report that many songs, including underrated, Bollywood, and other tracks, are not present, and that some content is only available as 30-second clips.

issues.name: Shuffle repeats songs and liked songs won't show
issues.summary: Customers report shuffle playing the same songs repeatedly, songs shuffling unexpectedly after an update, and the liked songs list not displaying.

issues.name: Unwanted recommendations appear in playlists
issues.summary: Customers say the app keeps adding recommended songs to their playlists even after turning that setting off, and dislike the content promoted on the platform.

issues.name: Connection fails over Wi-Fi with no-internet error
issues.summary: Customers report the app failing to connect to the internet over Wi-Fi and showing a no-connection message despite a good network.

issues.name: Subscription charges seen as too expensive
issues.summary: Customers feel the app charges too much for listening and replaying music and say they do not have spare money for the daily fees.

issues.name: Lyrics missing or incorrect for some songs
issues.summary: Customers report that lyrics are absent for some songs, wrong for others, and that lyric syncing is worse than on competing apps.

issues.name: Downloaded songs will not play offline
issues.summary: Customers say downloaded songs still require an internet connection to play, and that offline listening requires a paid subscription.

issues.name: Premium purchase not recognized by the app
issues.summary: Customers report paying for Premium but still seeing pause or upgrade screens, being unable to sign up for individual Premium, and being told they lack premium features.

issues.name: Search returns no results or wrong songs
issues.summary: Customers report that searching returns no results or that tapping a song plays a different track than the one selected.

issues.name: Downloaded songs and podcasts disappear
issues.summary: Customers report the download option missing despite a subscription, downloaded podcasts being deleted, and only some songs showing as downloaded.

issues.name: Music stops or changes when app is backgrounded
issues.summary: Customers report songs turning off when the app is closed or switched away from, and playback choosing random songs instead of the selected one.

issues.name: Sound quality poor and audio issues reported
issues.summary: Customers report no sound or poor sound quality, and say good audio is only usable by paying for Premium to avoid ads.

issues.name: Songs fail to download or loop and queue
issues.summary: Customers say they cannot download the songs they want, cannot add songs to the queue or loop them, and that free playback is limited to short clips with frequent ads.

issues.name: Unexpected charges and account losses reported
issues.summary: Customers report being charged large amounts while losing playlists after a hack, and feel the company is taking money unfairly.

issues.name: Notifications and friend activity features not working
issues.summary: Customers say friend activity is not visible even after enabling the settings, playback stops when the app is closed, and an unwanted rating popup appears.

issues.name: Account logs out on its own and cannot log back in
issues.summary: Customers report being logged out automatically, losing favorite songs, and being unable to log back in or pair a family account.

issues.name: Cannot create account or buy Premium
issues.summary: Customers report being unable to set up a new account or buy Premium correctly, and being blocked by the birth date entry during sign-up.

issues.name: Uninstall and boycott over unrelated issues
issues.summary: Customers uninstalled the app over unrelated political or cultural matters and expressed anger without describing an app problem.

issues.name: Podcast playback lags and speed controls fail
issues.summary: Customers report podcasts lagging for paying users, inability to play at faster speeds, and difficulty buying audiobooks.

issues.name: Support responses fail to resolve the problem
issues.summary: Customers say support gives a reason for an issue without explaining how to fix it and feel customer service is disappointing.

issues.name: App drains battery and keeps running in background
issues.summary: Customers report the app staying active when turned off, draining battery quickly since a recent update.

issues.name: Mixed feedback praising sound but noting storage use
issues.summary: Customers praise the app's sound quality and general experience while mentioning it is not as good as a competitor and uses a lot of phone storage.

issues.name: Support does not reply to customer messages
issues.summary: Customers say the company does not respond to their messages or reviews and that other users report the same lack of support.
